title: Knowledge Card
description: A Knowledge Card captures validated knowledge about a single bounded concept: the entities and relationships involved, the reasoning that connects them, the conditions under which that reasoning no longer holds, and the provenance of every claim. Grounded in a formal domain ontology and signed off by a domain expert. Copyright (c) 2026 Mondegreen.ai. Schema licensed under Apache-2.0.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. May be the canonical Mondegreen context IRI or an inline object.

@id.description: Optional IRI identifying this card individual.

@type.description: Must declare the card as a kc:KnowledgeCard.

kc:concept.description: The concept anchor: the ontology class IRI this card is about. This is what fixes the card's meaning against a formal domain ontology.

kc:domain.description: Human-readable domain label (e.g. 'Wind energy, drivetrain condition monitoring').

kc:meta.description: Provenance, lifecycle state, and the expert validation record.

kc:lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state. A card is authoritative only in the 'validated' state.

kc:version.description: Version string. Cards are versioned so that earlier decisions remain traceable to the knowledge that governed them.

kc:validatedBy.description: Identifier of the qualified domain expert who reviewed and signed off the card.

kc:ontologyVersion.description: Version of the domain ontology under which the card was checked.

kc:supersededBy.description: IRI of the card version that supersedes this one, if any.

kc:provenance.description: Source documents and records from which the card's claims were derived (PROV-O aligned).

kc:entities.description: The entity register: the individuals involved in the concept, each with a typed role, an observability class, and a criticality weight.

kc:entityRole.description: The role the entity plays in the card's reasoning.

kc:observability.description: How directly the entity can be observed.

kc:criticalityWeight.description: How much the entity contributes to the diagnosis, in [0,1].

kc:relationships.description: The relationship topology: named, ontology-grounded relationships between entities, each with a confidence score.

kc:property.description: Named relationship (ideally an ontology object-property IRI).

kc:reasoning.description: Layered reasoning. The layers are a ladder, not a checklist: a card carries as many as its knowledge supports. The narrative and rule layers are expected; the probabilistic layer is optional, present only when calibration data supports it.

kc:level1_narrative.description: Plain-language description of how the conclusion follows from the evidence. Required for human review.

kc:level2_pattern.description: Structured pattern: the signals, their thresholds, and the conclusion they support.

kc:level3_rule.description: Formal rule whose terms are ontology classes, applicable by a symbolic reasoner.

kc:level4_probabilistic.description: OPTIONAL. Present only when calibration data supports it. Captures that the same signal carries different weight in different contexts and that conflicting signals should shift a degree of belief rather than force a verdict.

kc:boundaries.description: Scope limits, typed by severity. A 'card-invalid' condition withdraws the card's authority to draw a conclusion; a 'requires-human-review' condition defers to a person; a 'degrades-gracefully' condition lowers confidence but continues.

kc:systemLink.description: Binds the card to the consuming system: embedding mode, endpoint, and inference configuration.
